claim: Standalone self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager, single binary, uses PostgreSQL
Docker Compose install and binary install with --new-config, --install, then ./listmonk on port 9000
Single and double opt-in lists; query and segment subscribers with SQL expressions
Go templating with 100+ functions in subject lines and content
Multi-threaded multi-SMTP queues with throughput and sliding window rate limiting
Analytics for campaign performance, bounces and top links
Production instance sending a campaign of 7+ million emails, peak RAM 57 MB
Listmonk has no affiliation with SMTP providers listed on the site
Feature list on the site has no automation or drip builder
